name: Live TV
description: Free TV channels and guides for Jellyfin's Live TV, from Samsung TV Plus, Pluto TV and Free-TV, numbered like Sky.
author: TheMightyTRexUK

settings.label: White channel logos
settings.hint: Turns each logo white on a clear background. Deactivated: channels keep their own logos.

settings.label: On TV now card shows
settings.hint: The dashboard's On TV now card: what is on now in this section. Add the card in Edit dashboard.

settings.label: Address Jellyfin uses to reach Starboard
settings.hint: For channel logos and Pluto TV streams, such as http://192.168.1.20:8095. Jellyfin must be able to open it.

settings.label: Live TV folder as Jellyfin sees it
settings.hint: Such as /config/iptv. Live TV adds its channels and guides to Jellyfin from there.

settings.label: Your lists and guides
settings.hint: Add your own channel lists (M3U or JSON) and guides (XMLTV) by address. Each has its own switch.

settings.label: Channels
settings.hint: Open a list to see its regions, sections and channels, each with its own switches. A channel you deactivate stays inactive when the lists are rebuilt.
